top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall on Inflation Worry as Oil Rises
top_signals.summary:
A record-breaking run in stocks hit a wall as higher oil prices lifted bond yields, stoking concerns that potential inflationary pressures could trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes.
Chuck Clough, Chairman at Clough Capital, discusses what he's seeing in current markets and whether we're facing an AI bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India Seeks Black Sea Deal as Merchant Ships Face Fresh Attacks
top_signals.summary: India is engaging Ukraine and Russia to ensure safe passage of grain and energy through the Black Sea as fresh attacks on commercial vessels continued to disrupt shipping and put its seafarers at risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US 30-Year Yields Return to 2002 High
top_signals.summary:
US Treasuries resumed their retreat, lifting the 30-year yield back to its highest since 2002 as climbing oil prices raised concern about faster inflation and more central bank interest-rate increases.
Vishal Khanduja, Head of Broad Markets Fixed Income at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, discusses credit spreads and whether or not yields will soon peak. (Source: Bloomberg)
